caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug or textile design composed of a grid of colorful, geometric shapes. The central area of the rug is divided into seven columns and five rows of squares, each square further subdivided diagonally into four triangles that form hourglass or bowtie-like patterns. The triangles are colored in various shades of green, red, yellow, pink, brown, black, blue, beige, and gray. These colored triangles are arranged so that each square contains contrasting and complementary colors, resulting in a visually dynamic composition. The arrangement is bordered by several frames: a thin inner black line, surrounded by a narrow light green border, a slightly wider tan or beige border, and finally an outermost thick border made up of irregular, dark gray textured strokes. The entire design is centered on a plain light beige or off-white background.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
